correctness.rationale: Every retained translation contributes two rank-one Gabor atoms on edge (k,k+1) with diagonal two at each endpoint and offdiagonal modulus 2q, q=|cos(pi*ell/N)| in (0,1). Removing pairs creates positive-length path components or isolated vertices. Gauging phases along each path gives the exact disjoint union of blocks 2H_m(q) with diagonal 1,2,...,2,1 and q super/subdiagonals. The eigenvalue alpha_m is the unique hyperbolic root t_m via q(cosh t+sinh t*tanh(mt/2))=1, and increases strictly with m; beta_m increases strictly from Perron-positive Rayleigh extension. Therefore the condition number is beta_(max gap)/alpha_(min gap). Integer averaging forces min gap<=floor((N-h)/h), max gap>=ceil((N-h)/h), and strict monotonicity makes precisely balanced positive gap lists optimal, counted by (N/h)*binomial(h,r). For h>N/2 an isolated vertex is unavoidable. Independent complex Hermitian operator reconstruction and numerical spectra for 18,966 N,ell,h,E combinations across 190 families with N=3..11 agreed with Jacobi blocks and optimal masks, after correcting an initial integer-dtype bug in the *independent test*; the all-N proof is analytic, not finite enumeration.
